fullText.simplified:
十四、木兰是女人

    木兰回到了老家，终于见到了她的家人。
    一个星期后的一天，木兰出门向街中心走去。木兰非常高兴，因为有几个军队的朋友在那儿等着她。木兰轻轻地走到大家的身后，她听到他们在聊天。
    “大成，木兰是让我们今天来这儿找他，对吧？他怎么还没来？”一个人说道。
    “没错，是这里，这是木兰的老家，他一定是让我们来这里找他玩儿的。”大成说道。
    “我第一次来，这个地方真漂亮啊！”又一个人说道。
    “这里的女人也很漂亮啊！”大成说道。
    “这里的女人不但漂亮，而且还很聪明，力气也非常大。”木兰笑着说道。
    是木兰的声音吗？大家马上回过头去，但是眼前的人让他们大吃一惊！
    什么？这是木兰？她穿着漂亮的裙子，她的头发长长的，她的耳边还有花。这……她是女人？花木兰是女人？在战场上冲在最前面的那个战士是个女人？！
    大家的嘴张得大大的，他们都说不出话来了……
    “你们好啊，我是花木兰！很高兴认识你们！”木兰笑了起来。
    “木兰，你……你太了不起了！”大成跳起来说。
    朋友们也都明白了，跟着大成跳了起来。
    “木兰真了不起！”大家一起说。
    后来，木兰参军上战场的事情慢慢地被全国的人知道了。每个听说了木兰事情的人，都觉得木兰是个了不起的女孩。而且从那以后，很多女人开始变得不一样了。她们学骑马，她们爬树玩儿。她们想穿裙子就穿裙子，想穿裤子就穿裤子。她们可以去工作，她们也可以在家里照顾家人。还有街中心的那个武馆，里面有了越来越多的女学生。木兰再也不用远远地看着了，她在武馆里面跟着大家一起踢腿，向后，再踢腿……
fullText.traditional:
十四、木蘭是女人

    木蘭回到了老家，終於見到了她的家人。
    一個星期後的一天，木蘭出門向街中心走去。木蘭非常高興，因為有幾個軍隊的朋友在那兒等著她。木蘭輕輕地走到大家的身後，她聽到他們在聊天。
    “大成，木蘭是讓我們今天來這兒找他，對吧？他怎麼還沒來？”一個人說道。
    “沒錯，是這裡，這是木蘭的老家，他一定是讓我們來這裡找他玩兒的。”大成說道。
    “我第一次來，這個地方真漂亮啊！”又一個人說道。
    “這裡的女人也很漂亮啊！”大成說道。
    “這裡的女人不但漂亮，而且還很聰明，力氣也非常大。”木蘭笑著說道。
    是木蘭的聲音嗎？大家馬上回過頭去，但是眼前的人讓他們大吃一驚！
    什麼？這是木蘭？她穿著漂亮的裙子，她的頭髮長長的，她的耳邊還有花。這……她是女人？花木蘭是女人？在戰場上衝在最前面的那個戰士是個女人？！
    大家的嘴張得大大的，他們都說不出話來了……
    “你們好啊，我是花木蘭！很高興認識你們！”木蘭笑了起來。
    “木蘭，你……你太了不起了！”大成跳起來說。
    朋友們也都明白了，跟著大成跳了起來。
    “木蘭真了不起！”大家一起說。
    後來，木蘭參軍上戰場的事情慢慢地被全國的人知道了。每個聽說了木蘭事情的人，都覺得木蘭是個了不起的女孩。而且從那以後，很多女人開始變得不一樣了。她們學騎馬，她們爬樹玩兒。她們想穿裙子就穿裙子，想穿褲子就穿褲子。她們可以去工作，她們也可以在家裡照顧家人。還有街中心的那個武館，裡面有了越來越多的女學生。木蘭再也不用遠遠地看著了，她在武館裡面跟著大家一起踢腿，向後，再踢腿……

sentences.simplified: 木兰回到了老家，终于见到了她的家人。
sentences.traditional: 木蘭回到了老家，終於見到了她的家人。
sentences.pinyin: mù lán huí dào le lǎo jiā zhōng yú jiàn dào le tā de jiā rén
sentences.english: Mulan returned to her hometown and finally saw her family.

sentences.simplified: 一个星期后的一天，木兰出门向街中心走去。
sentences.traditional: 一個星期後的一天，木蘭出門向街中心走去。
sentences.pinyin: yí ge xīng qī hòu de yì tiān mù lán chū mén xiàng jiē zhōng xīn zǒu qù
sentences.english: One day, a week later, Mulan went out and walked toward the center of the town.

sentences.simplified: 木兰非常高兴，因为有几个军队的朋友在那儿等着她。
sentences.traditional: 木蘭非常高興，因為有幾個軍隊的朋友在那兒等著她。
sentences.pinyin: mù lán fēi cháng gāo xìng yīn wèi yǒu jǐ ge jūn duì de péng you zài nà'r děng zhe tā
sentences.english: Mulan was very happy because several of her friends from the army were there waiting for her.

sentences.simplified: 木兰轻轻地走到大家的身后，她听到他们在聊天。
sentences.traditional: 木蘭輕輕地走到大家的身後，她聽到他們在聊天。
sentences.pinyin: mù lán qīng qīng de zǒu dào dà jiā de shēn hòu tā tīng dào tā men zài liáo tiān
sentences.english: Mulan quietly walked up behind everyone and heard them chatting.

sentences.simplified: “大成，木兰是让我们今天来这儿找他，对吧？他怎么还没来？”一个人说道。
sentences.traditional: “大成，木蘭是讓我們今天來這兒找他，對吧？他怎麼還沒來？”一個人說道。
sentences.pinyin: dà chéng mù lán shì ràng wǒ men jīn tiān lái zhè‘r zhǎo tā duì ba tā zěn me hái méi lái yí ge rén shuō dào
sentences.english: “Dacheng, Mulan is the one who asked us to come here today to see him, right? Why hasn’t he arrived yet?” one person said.

sentences.simplified: “没错，是这里，这是木兰的老家，他一定是让我们来这里找他玩儿的。”大成说道。
sentences.traditional: “沒錯，是這裡，這是木蘭的老家，他一定是讓我們來這裡找他玩兒的。”大成說道。
sentences.pinyin: méi cuò shì zhè lǐ zhè shì mù lán de lǎo jiā tā yí dìng shì ràng wǒ men lái zhè lǐ zhǎo tā wán'r de dà chéng shuō dào
sentences.english: “That’s right, it’s here. This is Mulan’s hometown. He must have asked us to come here to hang out,” Dacheng said.

sentences.simplified: “我第一次来，这个地方真漂亮啊！”又一个人说道。
sentences.traditional: “我第一次來，這個地方真漂亮啊！”又一個人說道。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ dì yī cì lái zhè ge dì fang zhēn piào liang a yòu yí ge rén shuō dào
sentences.english: “It’s my first time here. This place is really beautiful!” another person said.

sentences.simplified: “这里的女人也很漂亮啊！”大成说道。
sentences.traditional: “這裡的女人也很漂亮啊！”大成說道。
sentences.pinyin: zhè lǐ de nǚ rén yě hěn piào liang a dà chéng shuō dào
sentences.english: “The women here are also very beautiful!” Dacheng said.

sentences.simplified: “这里的女人不但漂亮，而且还很聪明，力气也非常大。”木兰笑着说道。
sentences.traditional: “這裡的女人不但漂亮，而且還很聰明，力氣也非常大。”木蘭笑著說道。
sentences.pinyin: zhè lǐ de nǚ rén bú dàn piào liang ér qiě hái hěn cōng ming lì qi yě fēi cháng dà mù lán xiào zhe shuō dào
sentences.english: “The women here are not only beautiful but also very smart and extremely strong,” Mulan said with a smile.

sentences.simplified: 是木兰的声音吗？大家马上回过头去，但是眼前的人让他们大吃一惊！
sentences.traditional: 是木蘭的聲音嗎？大家馬上回過頭去，但是眼前的人讓他們大吃一驚！
sentences.pinyin: shì mù lán de shēng yīn ma dà jiā mǎ shàng huí guò tóu qù dàn shì yǎn qián de rén ràng tā men dà chī yì jīng
sentences.english: Was that Mulan’s voice? Everyone immediately turned around, but the person in front of them took them by surprise!

sentences.simplified: 什么？这是木兰？她穿着漂亮的裙子，她的头发长长的，她的耳边还有花。
sentences.traditional: 什麼？這是木蘭？她穿著漂亮的裙子，她的頭髮長長的，她的耳邊還有花。
sentences.pinyin: shén me zhè shì mù lán tā chuān zhe piào liang de qún zi tā de tóu fa cháng cháng de tā de ěr biān hái yǒu huā
sentences.english: What? Is this Mulan? She was wearing a beautiful dress, her hair was long, and there were flowers by her ears.

sentences.simplified: 这……她是女人？花木兰是女人？在战场上冲在最前面的那个战士是个女人？！
sentences.traditional: 這……她是女人？花木蘭是女人？在戰場上衝在最前面的那個戰士是個女人？！
sentences.pinyin: zhè tā shì nǚ rén huā mù lán shì nǚ rén zài zhàn chǎng shang chōng zài zuì qián miàn de nà ge zhàn shì shì ge nǚ rén
sentences.english: This … she is a woman? Hua Mulan is a woman? That warrior who charged to the front of the battlefield is a woman?!

sentences.simplified: 大家的嘴张得大大的，他们都说不出话来了……
sentences.traditional: 大家的嘴張得大大的，他們都說不出話來了……
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā de zuǐ zhāng de dà dà de tā men dōu shuō bù chū huà lái le
sentences.english: Everyone’s mouths were wide open, and they were all speechless …

sentences.simplified: “你们好啊，我是花木兰！很高兴认识你们！”木兰笑了起来。
sentences.traditional: “你們好啊，我是花木蘭！很高興認識你們！”木蘭笑了起來。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ men hǎo a wǒ shì huā mù lán hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ men mù lán xiào le qǐ lái
sentences.english: “Hello, I am Hua Mulan! Nice to meet you!” Mulan said with a smile.

sentences.simplified: “木兰，你……你太了不起了！”大成跳起来说。
sentences.traditional: “木蘭，你……你太了不起了！”大成跳起來說。
sentences.pinyin: mù lán nǐ nǐ tài liǎo bu qǐ le dà chéng tiào qǐ lái shuō
sentences.english: “Mulan, you … you are truly amazing!” Dacheng jumped up and said.

sentences.simplified: 朋友们也都明白了，跟着大成跳了起来。
sentences.traditional: 朋友們也都明白了，跟著大成跳了起來。
sentences.pinyin: péng you men yě dōu míng bai le gēn zhe dà chéng tiào le qǐ lái
sentences.english: Her friends also understood and jumped up along with Dacheng.

sentences.simplified: “木兰真了不起！”大家一起说。
sentences.traditional: “木蘭真了不起！”大家一起說。
sentences.pinyin: mù lán zhēn liǎo bu qǐ dà jiā yì qǐ shuō
sentences.english: “Mulan is truly amazing!” everyone said together.

sentences.simplified: 后来，木兰参军上战场的事情慢慢地被全国的人知道了。
sentences.traditional: 後來，木蘭參軍上戰場的事情慢慢地被全國的人知道了。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái mù lán cān jūn shàng zhàn chǎng de shì qing màn man de bèi quán guó de rén zhī dào le
sentences.english: Later, the story of Mulan joining the army and going to the battlefield gradually became known throughout the country.

sentences.simplified: 每个听说了木兰事情的人，都觉得木兰是个了不起的女孩。
sentences.traditional: 每個聽說了木蘭事情的人，都覺得木蘭是個了不起的女孩。
sentences.pinyin: měi ge tīng shuō le mù lán shì qing de rén dōu jué de mù lán shì ge liǎo bu qǐ de nǚ hái
sentences.english: Everyone who heard about Mulan’s story thought she was an extraordinary girl.

sentences.simplified: 而且从那以后，很多女人开始变得不一样了。她们学骑马，她们爬树玩儿。
sentences.traditional: 而且從那以後，很多女人開始變得不一樣了。她們學騎馬，她們爬樹玩兒。
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě cóng nà yǐ hòu hěn duō nǚ rén kāi shǐ biàn de bù yí yàng le tā men xué qí mǎ tā men pá shù wán'r
sentences.english: And from then on, many women began to change. They learned to ride horses, and they climbed trees for fun.

sentences.simplified: 她们想穿裙子就穿裙子，想穿裤子就穿裤子。
sentences.traditional: 她們想穿裙子就穿裙子，想穿褲子就穿褲子。
sentences.pinyin: tā men xiǎng chuān qún zi jiù chuān qún zi xiǎng chuān kù zi jiù chuān kù zi
sentences.english: They wore dresses if they wanted to wear dresses, and they wore pants if they wanted to wear pants.

sentences.simplified: 她们可以去工作，她们也可以在家里照顾家人。
sentences.traditional: 她們可以去工作，她們也可以在家裡照顧家人。
sentences.pinyin: tā men kě yǐ qù gōng zuò tā men yě kě yǐ zài jiā lǐ zhào gù jiā rén
sentences.english: They could go to work, and they could also take care of their family at home.

sentences.simplified: 还有街中心的那个武馆，里面有了越来越多的女学生。
sentences.traditional: 還有街中心的那個武館，裡面有了越來越多的女學生。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu jiē zhōng xīn de nà ge wǔ guǎn lǐ miàn yǒu le yuè lái yuè duō de nǚ xué sheng
sentences.english: And the martial arts school in the center of the town had more and more female students.

sentences.simplified: 木兰再也不用远远地看着了，
sentences.traditional: 木蘭再也不用遠遠地看著了，
sentences.pinyin: mù lán zài yě bú yòng yuǎn yuǎn de kàn zhe le
sentences.english: Mulan no longer had to watch from afar.

sentences.simplified: 她在武馆里面跟着大家一起踢腿，向后，再踢腿……
sentences.traditional: 她在武館裡面跟著大家一起踢腿，向後，再踢腿……
sentences.pinyin: tā zài wǔ guǎn lǐ miàn gēn zhe dà jiā yì qǐ tī tuǐ xiàng hòu zài tī tuǐ
sentences.english: She was kicking her leg, stepping back, and then kicking again with everyone else in the martial arts school …

sentence_translations: (14) Mulan Is a Woman
Mulan returned to her hometown and finally saw her family.
One day, a week later, Mulan went out and walked toward the center of the town.
Mulan was very happy because several of her friends from the army were there waiting for her.
Mulan quietly walked up behind everyone and heard them chatting.
“Dacheng, Mulan is the one who asked us to come here today to see him, right? Why hasn’t he arrived yet?” one person said.
“That’s right, it’s here. This is Mulan’s hometown. He must have asked us to come here to hang out,” Dacheng said.
“It’s my first time here. This place is really beautiful!” another person said.
“The women here are also very beautiful!” Dacheng said.
“The women here are not only beautiful but also very smart and extremely strong,” Mulan said with a smile.
Was that Mulan’s voice? Everyone immediately turned around, but the person in front of them took them by surprise!
What? Is this Mulan? She was wearing a beautiful dress, her hair was long, and there were flowers by her ears.
This … she is a woman? Hua Mulan is a woman? That warrior who charged to the front of the battlefield is a woman?!
Everyone’s mouths were wide open, and they were all speechless …
“Hello, I am Hua Mulan! Nice to meet you!” Mulan said with a smile.
“Mulan, you … you are truly amazing!” Dacheng jumped up and said.
Her friends also understood and jumped up along with Dacheng.
“Mulan is truly amazing!” everyone said together.
Later, the story of Mulan joining the army and going to the battlefield gradually became known throughout the country.
Everyone who heard about Mulan’s story thought she was an extraordinary girl.
And from then on, many women began to change. They learned to ride horses, and they climbed trees for fun.
They wore dresses if they wanted to wear dresses, and they wore pants if they wanted to wear pants.
They could go to work, and they could also take care of their family at home.
And the martial arts school in the center of the town had more and more female students.
Mulan no longer had to watch from afar.
She was kicking her leg, stepping back, and then kicking again with everyone else in the martial arts school …
